style: A warm, mature Israeli woman speaking kindly and clearly to friends in the community, good natural Hebrew, light gentle smile in the voice, steady conversational pace (not slow, not rushed), a short pause between sentences.

lines.text: עִקְבוּ אַחֲרֵי הַהוֹדָעוֹת, וְהָכִינוּ סֶפַח תְּעוּדַת זֶהוּת פָּתוּחַ, שֶׁלָּכֶם וְשֶׁל כָּל יֶלֶד מֵעַל גִּיל שְׁמוֹנֶה עֶשְׂרֵה.
